messages:
Alex T.: Heads-up — customer SynthHealth reports being charged twice for the same annual renewal period. Invoices: INV-2026-878 (PO PO-889) and INV-2026-879 (card). Payment IDs: pay_3Jk9A... and pay_3Jk9B... Card last4: 4242. Customer pasted both receipts. They want a refund for the duplicate. @Jenn (Finance) can you advise next steps?
BillingBot: Created support ticket #SUP-11492 and attached receipts from customer.
Jenn (Finance): Thanks Alex. Can you confirm timestamps and the gateway transaction IDs? I need them for reconciliation and to issue the refund and credit memo. Also need the PO contact if we must refund the PO instead of issuing a credit.
Maria S.: Customer provided gateway txns: gw_txn_20260310_01 (for INV-878) at 2026-03-10T10:02:14Z and gw_txn_20260310_02 (for INV-879) at 2026-03-10T10:02:15Z — looks like 1s apart. They think they submitted the PO and then the card charged as a fallback.
Kyle O.: That 1s spacing smells like a race where both payment flows completed. Check our payments service logs for idempotency key reuse and webhook retries. Quick checks: 
```
# find invoices
SELECT id, invoice_number, status, created_at FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='synth-123' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
# view gateway events
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://payments.internal/api/v1/gateway_events?gateway_txn_id=gw_txn_20260310_01" | jq .
```
Emily R.: Confirmed both invoices are marked PAID in our DB and both gateway txns are CAPTURED. Webhook delivery to /webhooks/billing shows two distinct event_ids — looks like both finalised independently.
Jenn (Finance): Ok — plan: 1) Refund the card transaction (gw_txn_20260310_02) back to card — standard refund, reason: duplicate_payment. 2) For the PO (INV-878) we should issue a credit memo tied to PO-889, and mark invoice INV-878 as reversed so our billing reports don't double-count. I can run the card refund once ops confirms gateway refund window is OK.
Kyle O.: Gateway supports refunds immediately. I'll run idempotency checks and add a note to the payment record: `duplicate_auto_renew_race`. Also will block automatic retry path to avoid re-firing webhook to customer.
Maria S.: I'll message the customer: estimated 3-5 business days for the card refund to appear; credit memo will be applied immediately to their account and can be used for future invoices or refunded if requested.
Jenn (Finance): Proceeding now — issued refund via gateway: refund_id rfd_5Ff7Z (amount $12,000) against gw_txn_20260310_02. Created credit memo CM-2026-44 for INV-2026-878 referencing PO-889 and set invoice INV-2026-878 status to CREDIT_APPLIED.
Maria S.: Noted. Customer notified and replied :thumbsup:. They asked for confirmation email — sent with refund_id and credit memo PDF.
Alex T.: Thanks team. Can ops please add a postmortem note in the payments backlog about duplicate flows when both PO and card flows complete? Might be a UX fix (disable card fallback if PO submitted) or require stronger idempotency at orchestration layer.
Kyle O.: Will add a short postmortem to eng-infra/ payments backlog and assign to payment-orchestration. Logged root cause hypothesis: simultaneous fallback + no orchestration-level guard.
Jenn (Finance): All settled from finance side. Closing SUP-11492 after customer confirms refund on their end. :white_check_mark:
